question: Should OpenClaw adopt Codex 0.144.2's Guardian policy rollback for supported `tools.exec.mode: "auto"` sessions?
rationale: Updating the pin is necessary under the plugin's latest-dependency contract, but the package also changes a reachable automatic authorization reviewer, so the intended security posture cannot be inferred from packaging tests alone.

options.title: Accept upstream behavior
options.body: Merge the synchronized update after recording that Codex 0.144.2's official Guardian policy is the intended behavior for OpenClaw auto-review sessions.

options.title: Require approval scenarios
options.body: Hold merge until managed app-server runs demonstrate representative allowed, denied, and deferred approval outcomes under `tools.exec.mode: "auto"`.

recommendation.title: Accept upstream behavior
recommendation.body: Merge the synchronized update after recording that Codex 0.144.2's official Guardian policy is the intended behavior for OpenClaw auto-review sessions.
